where relevant. Do not claim future interfaces or performance targets are shipped.

## Review checklist

- [ ] This change is owner-authorized; no outside code is included without approved CLA/relicensing terms. A DCO alone is insufficient.
- [ ] Relevant tests/docs and compatibility or durability notes are updated.
- [ ] New dependencies and copied material have approved rights and preserved notices; no Tzeentch source is copied.
- [ ] No secrets, private recordings, model weights, or generated benchmark artifacts are included.
- [ ] Performance statements distinguish volatile/buffered work from durable acknowledgment.
